name: Baktalórántháza (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, white at the hoist and green at the fly, charged near the top with the town arms of Baktalórántháza (a red, white and green shield with a lion and a tree) above the name BAKTALÓRÁNTHÁZA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
